create_function_create_test_prompts: create a list of test prompts with sampling parameters and optional LoRA requests for multi-LoRA offline inference
create_function_initialize_engine: create and return an LLMEngine configured for multi-LoRA inference with specified max_loras and max_lora_rank
create_function_process_requests: create a prompt processing loop that adds requests to the engine and prints finished outputs
create_function_main: create a main entry point that initializes the engine, downloads LoRA adapters, and runs inference
run_example_multilora_inference: run the multi-LoRA offline inference example with base model and LoRA adapter requests
